claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not date OSS service or establish when the recorded occupation was held.
claims.match_notes: The grade supports enlisted Army classification. The index's blank rank remains preserved, and the full identifier remains private.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 84 and complete Army bulk comparison; three exact-name Army rows and one private-identifier match; official layout and occupation-code review; exact-name and 1922-birth-year OSS/CIA, sales/employer, obituary, institutional, Library of Congress (243 broad results), newspaper, directory and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The two nonmatching exact-name Army rows were rejected by identifier; cemetery and people-finder results lack a reliable OSS, identifier or employer bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: Sales clerks is published as a qualified occupation with uncertain timing, not an employer. No reliable named pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.
research_attempts.next_action: Identify the sales employer and Army-to-OSS chronology from Box 129.
